o.text: From Classical Persian پلکان, plural of پله (pilla, “step of a staircase”), whence the Azerbaijani pillə. Compare Armenian փիլաքյան (pʻilakʻyan) and Georgian ფილაქანი (pilakani).
From Proto-Turkic *arïg. Cognate with Chuvash ирт (irt, “to clean”), Chuvash ырӑ (yră, “good”).
Borrowed from Russian га́мбургер (gámburger), from English hamburger.
Calque of Russian реакти́вная систе́ма за́лпового огня́ (reaktívnaja sistéma zálpovovo ognjá).
From Proto-Turkic *ẹ̄ĺ (“friend, companion, mate”). Cognate with Turkish eş, Kyrgyz эш (eş, “friend”), Southern Altai эш (eš, “friend”), Tuvan эш (eş, “friend”), Northern Altai эш (eš, “friend”).
